_note: Brand line-up notes for the 'Which one should you buy?' block on brand and model pages. Numbers in the tables come from scooters.json; these notes only describe each family. Chetak variant features checked against Autocar India (17 Oct 2026), TimesDrive (26 Oct 2026) and BikeDekho variant guides.

families.name: Rizta
families.text: The family pick of the range: the biggest boot of any Ather and the most room for two.
The quickest Athers, built for riders who want pickup. The boot is the smallest in the range.

families.name: Konarc
families.text: The most affordable Athers, with a large boot and a lower top speed.

families.name: S1 X
families.text: The value end of Ola's range, with the same 90 km/h top speed across battery sizes.

families.name: S1 Pro
families.text: The faster Olas with the largest batteries Ola sells, for long daily rides.

families.name: Chetak 3501
families.text: The top variant: touch TFT screen with Google Maps navigation, keyless start, reverse mode and the fastest charging of the 35 series.

families.name: Chetak 3502
families.text: The middle variant: TFT screen with turn-by-turn navigation and a front disc brake, but a regular key.

families.name: Chetak 3503
families.text: The base 35 series variant: same 3.5 kWh battery, with a basic LCD, no navigation, a front drum brake and a lower top speed.

families.name: Chetak 3001
families.text: A 3 kWh Chetak with a colour LCD, for shorter daily rides at a lower price.

families.name: Chetak C2501
families.text: The entry Chetak with a 2.5 kWh battery, for short city trips.

faq.q: Is the Chetak battery LFP or NMC?
faq.a: Bajaj does not publish the cell chemistry. Its FAQs only say the Chetak uses advanced chemistry lithium-ion cells. What you can count on is the 3 year or 50,000 km battery warranty, and the real range we list for each variant.
If you want navigation and keyless start, the 3501. If you want the same battery and range for less, the 3503 is the value pick. The 3502 sits in between with a TFT screen and a front disc brake.
